say:1:1622533001:1.text: I... I killed Perri. It was me...
say:1:1622533001:1.source_cn: 我……是我杀死了皮瑞……我杀了……

say:2:1622533002:1.text: Please... just go. I don't want to hurt anyone again. I did this...

choice_prompt:3:1622533002.text: Please... just go. I don't want to hurt anyone again. I did this...

say:4:1622533003:1.text: The giant tree doesn't respond. It only mutters to itself, lost in its own grief...
say:4:1622533003:1.source_cn: 巨树没有回应你，它喃喃自语，沉浸在悲伤之中……
say:4:1622533003:1.male: The giant tree doesn't respond. It only mutters to itself, lost in its own grief...
say:4:1622533003:1.female: The giant tree doesn't respond. It only mutters to itself, lost in its own grief...

choice_prompt:5:1622533003.text: The giant tree doesn't respond. It only mutters to itself, lost in its own grief...
choice_prompt:5:1622533003.source_cn: 巨树没有回应你，它喃喃自语，沉浸在悲伤之中……
choice_prompt:5:1622533003.male: The giant tree doesn't respond. It only mutters to itself, lost in its own grief...
choice_prompt:5:1622533003.female: The giant tree doesn't respond. It only mutters to itself, lost in its own grief...

say:6:1622533004:1.text: Who are you? How do you know that name?!
say:6:1622533004:1.source_cn: 你是谁？！为什么知道这个名字？！
say:6:1622533004:1.male: Who are you? How do you know that name?!
say:6:1622533004:1.female: Who are you? How do you know that name?!

say:7:1622533005:1.text: Only Perri knew that name. No one else was supposed to.
say:7:1622533005:1.source_cn: 除了皮瑞，不应该有人知道……根语这个名字。

choice_prompt:8:1622533005.text: Only Perri knew that name. No one else was supposed to.
choice_prompt:8:1622533005.source_cn: 除了皮瑞，不应该有人知道……根语这个名字。

say:9:1622533006:1.text: Talking Root goes utterly silent after reading the letter. It's like watching years of frozen guilt slowly thaw. After a long while, a low voice finally rises from its trunk.
say:9:1622533006:1.source_cn: 阅完信件后的根语陷入了长久的静默，一团冻结的坚冰在缓慢...
say:9:1622533006:1.male: Talking Root goes utterly silent after reading the letter. It's like watching years of frozen guilt slowly thaw. After a long while, a low voice finally rises from its trunk.
say:9:1622533006:1.female: Talking Root goes utterly silent after reading the letter. It's like watching years of frozen guilt slowly thaw. After a long while, a low voice finally rises from its trunk.

say:10:1622533007:1.text: *Sigh* Years ago, something dark took hold of me. It twisted my mind until I lost myself, and I lashed out without knowing who or what I was striking.
say:10:1622533007:1.source_cn: 唉……许多年前，我受到了某种黑暗力量的侵蚀腐化，神志常...

say:11:1622533008:1.text: Perri tended to me every day... It helped, slowly. One day, after he finished treating me, I fell into a deep sleep.
say:11:1622533008:1.source_cn: 皮瑞他……他一直在治疗我，我的状况在慢慢好转。有一次治...

say:12:1622533009:1.text: When I woke... I saw him lying there, lifeless. And the scent of corruption on him... it was the same as mine. I knew it instantly.
say:12:1622533009:1.source_cn: 等我醒来时，我在森林里看到了……看到了皮瑞的尸体。他的...

say:13:1622533010:1.text: <style="highlight">I thought I had struck him down in my madness</style>... <style="highlight">I never received his letter</style>... so all these years, I kept believing I had taken my only friend from this world...

choice_prompt:14:1622533010.text: <style="highlight">I thought I had struck him down in my madness</style>... <style="highlight">I never received his letter</style>... so all these years, I kept believing I had taken my only friend from this world...
choice_prompt:14:1622533010.source_cn: <style=highlight>我以为是我在混乱中杀死了他</style>……<style=highlight>我没有收到信</style>……我不知道……我一直以为……

say:15:1622533011:1.text: The guilt wrapped around me like a vine. And as the corruption grew, my mind only slipped further away...
say:15:1622533011:1.source_cn: 那种负罪感就像藤蔓一样缠绕着我的心。随着侵蚀加深，我…...

say:16:1622533012:1.text: <style="highlight">Anyone who set foot in the forest... I saw them as carriers of the corruption. I called to them, drew them closer, and... took their lives.</style>

say:17:1622533013:1.text: Other times, I thought they were Perri. I wanted to keep them here forever so he wouldn't leave me again...
say:17:1622533013:1.source_cn: 有时候，我又会把他们当作皮瑞，想把他们永远留在森林里……

say:18:1622533014:1.text: Once, a human burned away part of the corruption on my body. He was looking for a friend's lost cat. For a moment, the pain cleared my mind... and it reminded me of Perri, of the kindness he showed me...
say:18:1622533014:1.source_cn: 有一次，一个人类用火焰烧掉了我身上的部分病变，他是为了...

say:19:1622533015:1.text: I managed to let that man go, but only that once. Most days, I had no control over myself...
say:19:1622533015:1.source_cn: 我放走了他，但大多数时候我都控制不住自己……

choice_prompt:20:1622533015.text: I managed to let that man go, but only that once. Most days, I had no control over myself...
choice_prompt:20:1622533015.source_cn: 我放走了他，但大多数时候我都控制不住自己……

say:21:1622533016:1.text: I'm glad I didn't hurt him. And... I'm sorry.
say:21:1622533016:1.source_cn: 还好我没有伤害到他，我很抱歉……

say:22:1622533017:1.text: This letter... after all these years... thank you for bringing it to me. But... oh...
say:22:1622533017:1.source_cn: 这封信……这封迟到了这么多年的信……谢谢你带来这封信…...
say:22:1622533017:1.male: This letter... after all these years... thank you for bringing it to me. But... oh...
say:22:1622533017:1.female: This letter... after all these years... thank you for bringing it to me. But... oh...

say:23:1622533018:1.text: The sorrow still hangs over the giant tree. Magic can fix the corruption on the outside, but it can't heal what's hurting inside. Only love and kindness can do that.
say:23:1622533018:1.source_cn: 低落的情绪仍然盘踞在根语身上，虽然魔法能消除病变的表征...
say:23:1622533018:1.male: The sorrow still hangs over the giant tree. Magic can fix the corruption on the outside, but it can't heal what's hurting inside. Only love and kindness can do that.
say:23:1622533018:1.female: The sorrow still hangs over the giant tree. Magic can fix the corruption on the outside, but it can't heal what's hurting inside. Only love and kindness can do that.

choice:14:1:2.text: You should have read this long ago.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 这封信本该早点让你看到
choice:14:1:2.male: You should have read this long ago.
choice:14:1:2.female: You should have read this long ago.

choice:5:0:1.text: Talking Root! I need to speak to you!
choice:5:0:1.male: Talking Root! I need to speak to you!
choice:5:0:1.female: Talking Root! I need to speak to you!

say:0:1622534001:0.text: Colm should be done with the emergency by now. Time to meet him near the wheat fields.
say:0:1622534001:0.source_cn: 科尔姆应该处理完突发事务了，先去商业街与他会合吧。
say:0:1622534001:0.male: Colm should be done with the emergency by now. Time to meet him near the wheat fields.
say:0:1622534001:0.female: Colm should be done with the emergency by now. Time to meet him near the wheat fields.

say:1:1622535001:1.text: So <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, you've reached a conclusion about Silentwood?
say:1:1622535001:1.male: So <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, you've reached a conclusion about Silentwood?
say:1:1622535001:1.female: So <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, you've reached a conclusion about Silentwood?

choice_prompt:2:1622535001.text: So <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, you've reached a conclusion about Silentwood?
choice_prompt:2:1622535001.source_cn: <style=highlight><player_name></style>，想必是禁语森林一事的调查已有结论？
choice_prompt:2:1622535001.male: So <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, you've reached a conclusion about Silentwood?
choice_prompt:2:1622535001.female: So <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, you've reached a conclusion about Silentwood?

say:3:1622535002:1.text: What a tragedy... but thanks to you, the truth won't stay buried any longer.
say:3:1622535002:1.source_cn: 令人唏嘘，所幸有你的帮助，不然所有人都将被继续蒙蔽。
say:3:1622535002:1.male: What a tragedy... but thanks to you, the truth won't stay buried any longer.
say:3:1622535002:1.female: What a tragedy... but thanks to you, the truth won't stay buried any longer.

say:4:1622535003:1.text: Don't worry. Whoever brought that corruption into the forest, I'll track them down. I don't care how long ago it happened, they're not walking away from this.
say:4:1622535003:1.source_cn: 请放心，我会着手追查入侵者与腐化传播的幕后之人，纵使时...

say:5:1622535004:1.text: And the people of Starfall County deserve the truth. I'll put out an official notice so they finally know what really happened to the giant tree.
say:5:1622535004:1.source_cn: 另外，我将会发布通告，向星湖郡的民众公布巨树事件的真相始末。

say:0:1622536001:0.text: Poor tree... Perhaps Jorge and Saro can help with its guilt.
say:0:1622536001:0.source_cn: 根语还需要些朋友，嗯……豪尔赫和萨略，他俩应该会是合适...
say:0:1622536001:0.male: Poor tree... Perhaps Jorge and Saro can help with its guilt.
say:0:1622536001:0.female: Poor tree... Perhaps Jorge and Saro can help with its guilt.

say:0:1622537001:0.text: Looks like they're still arguing. Some habits die hard.
say:0:1622537001:0.source_cn: 萨略和豪尔赫这俩人怎么还在吵架。
say:0:1622537001:0.male: Looks like they're still arguing. Some habits die hard.
say:0:1622537001:0.female: Looks like they're still arguing. Some habits die hard.

say:1:1622539001:1.text: Oh, it's you again! So? Did you finally prove that forest is as deadly as I've been saying?
say:1:1622539001:1.source_cn: 年轻人，你又来了！怎么样，是不是找到禁语森林十分危险的...
say:1:1622539001:1.male: Oh, it's you again! So? Did you finally prove that forest is as deadly as I've been saying?
say:1:1622539001:1.female: Oh, it's you again! So? Did you finally prove that forest is as deadly as I've been saying?

say:2:1622539002:1.text: You explain everything—the corruption, Perri's letter, the giant tree's suffering.
say:2:1622539002:1.source_cn: 你向二人详细转述了在禁语森林的发现，以及巨树根语的真相。
say:2:1622539002:1.male: You explain everything—the corruption, Perri's letter, the giant tree's suffering.
say:2:1622539002:1.female: You explain everything—the corruption, Perri's letter, the giant tree's suffering.

say:3:1622539003:1.text: Silence falls between them. The only sound is the wind moving through the wheat.
say:3:1622539003:1.source_cn: 一阵沉默压在二人之间，只有风吹过麦子的声音隐隐传来。
say:3:1622539003:1.male: Silence falls between them. The only sound is the wind moving through the wheat.
say:3:1622539003:1.female: Silence falls between them. The only sound is the wind moving through the wheat.

say:4:1622539004:1.text: Jorge speaks first. His voice is shaky, full of disbelief.
say:4:1622539004:1.source_cn: 豪尔赫率先开口打破了沉默，他的声音带着难以置信的颤抖。
say:4:1622539004:1.male: Jorge speaks first. His voice is shaky, full of disbelief.
say:4:1622539004:1.female: Jorge speaks first. His voice is shaky, full of disbelief.

say:6:1622539005:1.text: Talking Root... So that was its name. Perri gave it that name... feels heavy, but kind too.
say:6:1622539005:1.source_cn: 根语……原来它有自己的名字。皮瑞先生赋予的名字……多么...

say:7:1622539006:1.text: And when it woke and saw the same corruption on Perri... it really believed it had killed him.
say:7:1622539006:1.source_cn: 所以，它醒来时，看到皮瑞身上那与它同源的腐化伤痕，便认...

say:8:1622539007:1.text: And we had no idea that letter even existed...
say:8:1622539007:1.source_cn: 而我们都不知道那封能解释一切的信……

say:9:1622539008:1.text: So when it grabbed me and kept muttering about killing Perri...
say:9:1622539008:1.source_cn: 所以……它缠绕我时，喃喃自语说杀了皮瑞……

choice_prompt:10:1622539008.text: So when it grabbed me and kept muttering about killing Perri...
choice_prompt:10:1622539008.source_cn: 所以……它缠绕我时，喃喃自语说杀了皮瑞……

say:11:1622539009:1.text: So when I burned that part of its bark, I must've hit the corrupted spot. Maybe the pain snapped something loose in its mind. Maybe that's why it let me go—it remembered Perri.
say:11:1622539009:1.source_cn: 这样看来，我当时用火焰魔法灼烧的，是它的病变之处，这短...

say:12:1622539010:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这是何等的残酷……

say:14:1622539012:1.text: I... I kept thinking about how gentle and kind the forest used to be. I didn't want to believe it had changed.
say:14:1622539012:1.source_cn: 我……我只顾着许多年前森林给予我的善意，就固执地认定后...

say:15:1622539013:1.text: You went in there for me, looking for Bibi, and you almost didn't make it back. And I still brushed off what you went through...
say:15:1622539013:1.source_cn: 你冒着风险进入森林，是为了替我寻回包包，我却……我却用...

say:16:1622539014:1.text: I'm sorry. I let my stubbornness get the best of me.
say:16:1622539014:1.source_cn: 请你原谅我这个老糊涂。

say:17:1622539015:1.text: Took you long enough to admit that! But to be fair, I wasn't any better. I was too hot-headed, too quick to judge. I let what I saw and heard blind me.
say:17:1622539015:1.source_cn: 哼，你也知道你固执得像头老骡子！但我也有错，我脾气太急...

say:18:1622539016:1.text: When you were in danger, I could see it immediately and ran to help. But when you kept insisting the forest wasn't what it seemed, I never stopped to ask what you meant.
say:18:1622539016:1.source_cn: 听到你有危险我能冲上去，可听到你坚持的东西……却没想过...

say:19:1622539017:1.text: I was so stuck in my own head I nearly dragged us both into the dark!
say:19:1622539017:1.source_cn: 我这糟糕的性子，差点让我们都成了瞎子！

say:20:1622539018:1.text: I kept remembering how good things used to be, and you only saw how bad they'd become. Neither of us bothered to connect the two.
say:20:1622539018:1.source_cn: 我们俩啊，一个只顾着回头看从前的阳光，忘了森林也会变天...

say:21:1622539019:1.text: We both got it wrong. More than we'd like to admit.
say:21:1622539019:1.source_cn: 我们都错了，萨略，错得厉害。

say:22:1622539020:1.text: Alright, old man, that's enough. Let's call it done and stop picking at old wounds.
say:22:1622539020:1.source_cn: 行了，老家伙！过去的事，就让它留在过去吧。我们的争吵，...

choice_prompt:23:1622539020.text: Alright, old man, that's enough. Let's call it done and stop picking at old wounds.
choice_prompt:23:1622539020.source_cn: 行了，老家伙！过去的事，就让它留在过去吧。我们的争吵，该结束了。

say:24:1622539021:1.text: Thank you, young mage. Without you, I might've lost him for good...
say:24:1622539021:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，年轻人，要是没有你，我会永远失去一位珍贵的朋友……
say:24:1622539021:1.male: Thank you, young mage. Without you, I might've lost him for good...
say:24:1622539021:1.female: Thank you, young mage. Without you, I might've lost him for good...

say:25:1622539023:1.text: Alright, enough mushy talk! Come on. From now on, we're checking in on that big fellow together!
say:25:1622539023:1.source_cn: 少来这套肉麻话！走吧，以后，咱们一起做那棵大家伙的朋友！

say:26:1622539024:1.text: It should know this much: Perri may be gone, but it's still got people who care about it!
say:26:1622539024:1.source_cn: 得让它知道，皮瑞虽然不在了，但关心它的人，还有着呢！

choice:23:0:1.text: Good. I'm glad you two finally came around.
choice:23:0:1.male: Good. I'm glad you two finally came around.
choice:23:0:1.female: Good. I'm glad you two finally came around.

say:28:1622539022:1.text: Yeah, we're done fighting! Thank you, young mage. Without you, I might've lost him for good...
say:28:1622539022:1.source_cn: 嗯，不吵了！谢谢你，年轻人，要是没有你，我会永远失去一...
say:28:1622539022:1.male: Yeah, we're done fighting! Thank you, young mage. Without you, I might've lost him for good...
say:28:1622539022:1.female: Yeah, we're done fighting! Thank you, young mage. Without you, I might've lost him for good...

choice:23:1:2.text: So, you two are good now?
choice:23:1:2.male: So, you two are good now?
choice:23:1:2.female: So, you two are good now?

choice:10:0:1.text: It wasn't boasting. It was his guilt talking.
choice:10:0:1.male: It wasn't boasting. It was his guilt talking.
choice:10:0:1.female: It wasn't boasting. It was his guilt talking.

say:0:1622540001:1.text: The air is thick with the scent of rot and sorrow—a silent mourning that's lasted far too long.
say:0:1622540001:1.source_cn: 腐朽与哀伤交织的余味浸透了每一寸空气，那是无言的悲鸣，...
say:0:1622540001:1.male: The air is thick with the scent of rot and sorrow—a silent mourning that's lasted far too long.
say:0:1622540001:1.female: The air is thick with the scent of rot and sorrow—a silent mourning that's lasted far too long.

say:1:1622540002:1.text: The giant tree, Talking Root, stands before you, wordless. Its heavy branches hang low, weighed down by years of grief.
say:1:1622540002:1.source_cn: 庞大的巨树——根语，枝叶低垂，沉默地矗立在你们面前。
say:1:1622540002:1.male: The giant tree, Talking Root, stands before you, wordless. Its heavy branches hang low, weighed down by years of grief.
say:1:1622540002:1.female: The giant tree, Talking Root, stands before you, wordless. Its heavy branches hang low, weighed down by years of grief.

say:3:1622540003:1.text: Hey there... it's Jorge. Years ago, I got lost out here, and you and Perri helped me find my way.
say:3:1622540003:1.source_cn: 树先生，我是豪尔赫。很多年前，我曾迷失在森林中，是你和...

say:5:1622540004:1.text: And it's me, Saro. I'm the one who burned your bark back then. Don't know if you remember.
say:5:1622540004:1.source_cn: 还有我，老家伙，我叫萨略。那个用火焰烫伤过你的人类，不...

say:7:1622540005:1.text: Talking Root doesn't speak, but one of its sagging branches lifts ever so slightly.
say:7:1622540005:1.source_cn: 根语依然沉默，但低垂的枝条似乎不易察觉地抬高了一点点。
say:7:1622540005:1.male: Talking Root doesn't speak, but one of its sagging branches lifts ever so slightly.
say:7:1622540005:1.female: Talking Root doesn't speak, but one of its sagging branches lifts ever so slightly.

say:9:1622540006:1.text: If Perri were here, he wouldn't want you shutting yourself away like this. He'd want you to heal.
say:9:1622540006:1.source_cn: 要是皮瑞先生还活着，他绝不会愿意看到你现在这样，把自己...

say:10:1622540007:1.text: Everything he did... he did it hoping you'd get better and keep watching over this forest.
say:10:1622540007:1.source_cn: 他把生命留在这片森林，是希望你能好起来，继续守护这片森林。

say:12:1622540008:1.text: Perri... If I hadn't been lost to the corruption... I could've saved him. And all the others I hurt...
say:12:1622540008:1.source_cn: 皮瑞……要是我清醒着……一定能救他……我还杀了那么多无...

say:13:1622540009:1.text: I can't live with this. This guilt... it's too much.
say:13:1622540009:1.source_cn: 这份罪孽……太沉重……我无法释怀……

say:15:1622540010:1.text: It wasn't your fault, Talking Root. That corruption twisted everything you felt and saw. If you stay buried in guilt, you'll only go further from what Perri wanted for you.
say:15:1622540010:1.source_cn: 那不是你的错，根语。是那股黑暗力量蒙蔽了你。如果你一直...

say:17:1622540011:1.text: Listen, big guy! None of us can change what happened. But we can face what comes next, together!
say:17:1622540011:1.source_cn: 听着，大家伙！过去的事，谁也扳不回来了。但往后的事，咱...

say:18:1622540012:1.text: I might be an old grump, but I stick to my word! You've got me, and you've got Jorge, whether you like it or not!
say:18:1622540012:1.source_cn: 我萨略，别的不行，但说到做到！以后，我跟你，还有老糊涂...

say:19:1622540013:1.text: Anyone tries to bring that corruption back, they'll have to answer to us first. How's that sound, Talking Root?
say:19:1622540013:1.source_cn: 有人敢来森林撒野，传播那该死的腐化，我保管不答应！怎么...

choice_prompt:20:1622540013.text: Anyone tries to bring that corruption back, they'll have to answer to us first. How's that sound, Talking Root?
choice_prompt:20:1622540013.source_cn: 有人敢来森林撒野，传播那该死的腐化，我保管不答应！怎么样，根语！

say:21:1622540014:1.text: Talking Root, we'll visit you. Talk to you. Keep you company. Perri did that for you, and we can do it too.
say:21:1622540014:1.source_cn: 根语，我们会常来看你，跟你说话，告诉你森林外面的事情，...

say:22:1622540015:1.text: And who knows... maybe we'll even track down some of Bibi's descendants. Bring a little life back into this place.
say:22:1622540015:1.source_cn: 也许……也许还能帮你找找包包的后代们，让这片森林重新热...

say:24:1622540016:1.text: Hey, I'm Colm, Sheriff of Starfall County. I'll take care of the investigation. The people who brought that corruption here won't get away with it. And I'll make sure everyone in Starfall County learns the truth!
say:24:1622540016:1.source_cn: 根语先生，我是星湖郡治安官科尔姆，请放心，我将着手追查...

say:26:1622540017:1.text: Friends... you called me Talking Root...

say:27:1622540018:1.text: Perri gave me that name. It's been so long since anyone spoke to me like that. Thank you... all of you.
say:27:1622540018:1.source_cn: 皮瑞给我起的名字……已经……很久很久没有生命这样呼唤我...

say:29:1622540019:1.text: Like waking from a long and heavy slumber, something begins to stir within the giant tree's branches—something warm and alive.
say:29:1622540019:1.source_cn: 如同从一场漫长而沉重的冬眠中苏醒，似乎有某种温暖的存在...
say:29:1622540019:1.male: Like waking from a long and heavy slumber, something begins to stir within the giant tree's branches—something warm and alive.
say:29:1622540019:1.female: Like waking from a long and heavy slumber, something begins to stir within the giant tree's branches—something warm and alive.

say:31:1622540020:1.text: That's more like it! Chin up, old fellow! From now on, this is our meeting spot!
say:31:1622540020:1.source_cn: 这就对了嘛！振作起来，老伙计！以后这儿，就是咱们碰头的...

say:32:1622540021:1.text: Come on, young mage. We've got work to do. Time to make a plan for tracking down those rotten scoundrels who started all this!
say:32:1622540021:1.source_cn: 年轻人，咱们得好好盘算盘算，怎么把那些散播腐化的混蛋揪出来！

say:34:1622540022:1.text: You agree with Saro, and promise to contact the Serene Lyceum to give Professor Perri the proper burial he deserves.
say:34:1622540022:1.source_cn: 你同意了萨略的提议，并表示将联系莱希拉姆学院，为皮瑞老...
say:34:1622540022:1.male: You agree with Saro, and promise to contact the Serene Lyceum to give Professor Perri the proper burial he deserves.
say:34:1622540022:1.female: You agree with Saro, and promise to contact the Serene Lyceum to give Professor Perri the proper burial he deserves.

narration:35:1622540023:1.text: Jorge and Saro both nod with a smile. Talking Root's leaves rustle softly overhead, as if celebrating this newfound friendship...

choice:20:1:2.text: Me too. No way I'm letting that happen again!
choice:20:1:2.male: Me too. No way I'm letting that happen again!
choice:20:1:2.female: Me too. No way I'm letting that happen again!

say:0:1622541001:1.text: Talking Root is back to normal. Silentwood won't be silent anymore. Life will return.
say:0:1622541001:1.source_cn: 根语恢复了正常，禁语森林——以后那里将会很热闹，再也不...
say:0:1622541001:1.male: Talking Root is back to normal. Silentwood won't be silent anymore. Life will return.
say:0:1622541001:1.female: Talking Root is back to normal. Silentwood won't be silent anymore. Life will return.

say:1:1622541002:1.text: Maybe it's time to ask Colm if this place should be called something else now.
say:1:1622541002:1.source_cn: 或许你该向科尔姆提议，修改一下它的名字？
say:1:1622541002:1.male: Maybe it's time to ask Colm if this place should be called something else now.
say:1:1622541002:1.female: Maybe it's time to ask Colm if this place should be called something else now.

say:3:1622541003:1.text: That's not something I can decide on my own. I'll need to report everything to my superiors first.
say:3:1622541003:1.source_cn: 这并非我所能决定的，我需要返回星湖郡，向上级汇报所有细节。

say:4:1622541004:1.text: Until then, it'll stay as it is. People are used to the old name. But I'll make sure the idea is in my report.
say:4:1622541004:1.source_cn: 在上级做出正式决定之前，这里还是叫做禁语森林吧——大家...

say:5:1622541005:1.text: Whatever they decide, at least things here have settled. And... thank you for everything you've done!
say:5:1622541005:1.source_cn: 不管是否能改名，总之，巨树之事暂可告一段落，非常感谢你...
say:5:1622541005:1.male: Whatever they decide, at least things here have settled. And... thank you for everything you've done!
say:5:1622541005:1.female: Whatever they decide, at least things here have settled. And... thank you for everything you've done!
